partition: held-out identifier/world seeds; same scenario structures

method.world: Each alternative is executed in a cloned hidden world, the v7 exploitation policy continues for 3 ticks (identical continuation for every alternative), the shared pipeline finishes, and the result is scored with fixture truth: +1 hidden site, +0.8 validated true wallet, +0.6 linkage discriminated, +0.6 contradiction resolved, +1 report ready, -0.3 wrong-operation proposal, -0.004 per request.
method.table: Investigation-level Director actions use explicit outcome tables (rationale in bench-adaptive/scenarios.mjs).

policies.v8: production scientificChoice on the identical eligible candidate pool
policies.confirmation: prefer related hunts and artifact searches over contradiction/temporal checks; no truth access
policies.v7: production v7 choose() with its bounded deterministic exploration
policies.v6: v6 operation policy (seed-only related hunt / Hunter after contradiction); v5 Director value/cost order for Director scenarios
